visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-white/10) for structure. Never use heavy box shadows, rely on borders and subtle background differences.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use subtle glows on active elements. E.g. focus:ring-yellow-500/30
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky headers or context menus: bg-[#050B14]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10.

motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 for cards. Background color shifts for buttons.
motion.loading: Use ASCII spinners or subtle pulsing borders instead of generic loading circles.

image_urls.description: Dark glowing motherboard - use for landing page hero background with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70)
Black flat screen monitor - use in features section
Students assembling robotics - use for community/templates showcase
Woman working late with code - use to represent the engineering workflow

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA. Muted text should not be darker than #64748B.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus states (ring-yellow-500).
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons for all UI elements. Use a bold/filled icon for the HRL logo (like Cpu or Hexagon) colored in text-yellow-500.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a single-page app with React Router.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the landing page (no Shadcn cards, just pure divs for maximum design freedom).
For the IDE layout (Dashboard, Workspace), use a fixed sidebar (`w-64`) and a main content area (`calc(100vw-16rem)`).
Implement the Workspace as a grid or flex layout using Shadcn Resizable panels (`components/ui/resizable.jsx`) to mimic VS Code.
Use Monaco Editor (via `@monaco-editor/react`) for code editing, configured with a dark theme like 'vs-dark'.
Integrate Shadcn Tabs for the Output section (Code, Explanation, Libraries, Connections, Optimization, Download).
Use Shadcn Select for Board and Language selection in the prompt area.
DO NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk. Use Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Add these via Google Fonts in index.html.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds where text overlays images; always use a backdrop blur or solid dark scrim.
Use the dark theme as default and only theme.
Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and major containers.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use grid/bento layouts or asymmetrical spacing.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (e.g. fixed sidebars, floating prompt bars).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific properties.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
